title: DUNGEON DIVE: Aim for the Deepest Level
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Kanami is visiting his sick younger sister in hospital when he wakes in a deadly 100-floor labyrinth in a fantasy world. Legend says reaching the deepest level grants a wish, so he pushes downward to get home, helped by magic and an unnamed skill that steadies him when overwhelmed but disturbs his emotions and mind (Seven Seas blurb via AniList/MU; Honey's Anime review of volume 1).
life_message: Love for family drives you through danger, but power that numbs your feelings has a hidden price.
